question: Which of the following non-metals exhibits a metallic lustre despite being chemically non-metallic?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Iodine**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Iodine** is a non-metal but exhibits a **metallic lustre**. This is a unique characteristic among non-metals.
 
• The metallic lustre of iodine is due to the **reflection of light** by its closely packed molecules arranged in a crystalline structure.
 
• Iodine appears as a **shiny, dark gray or purple solid**, which is why it is often mistaken for a metal based on its appearance.
 
• Unlike metals, iodine is brittle and does not exhibit properties like ductility or malleability, affirming its classification as a non-metal.
 
• Iodine sublimates upon heating, transitioning directly from a solid to a purple vapor, which is a characteristic property of non-metals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Characteristics of Sulphur:**

 
 
• It is a **brittle yellow solid** at room temperature.
 
• It does not exhibit metallic lustre and is classified as a **non-metal**.
 
• Commonly used in the production of **sulfuric acid, fertilizers, and fireworks**.
 
 
 
• **Characteristics of Phosphorus:**
 
 
• Exists in several allotropic forms, such as **white, red, and black phosphorus**.
 
• It does not exhibit metallic lustre; instead, white phosphorus is waxy and translucent, while red phosphorus is powdery.
 
• It is essential for biological processes and is a key component of **DNA, RNA, and ATP**.
 
 
 
• **Characteristics of Nitrogen:**
 
 
• Nitrogen is a **colorless, odorless gas** at room temperature.
 
• It does not exhibit metallic lustre and is found abundantly in the **Earth’s atmosphere (78%)**.
 
• It plays a crucial role in the synthesis of **proteins and nucleic acids** in living organisms.
 
 
 
• **Properties of Iodine:**
 
 
• Iodine is a **halogen** and belongs to Group 17 of the periodic table.
 
• It is widely used in **medicine** as an antiseptic and in the **iodization of salt** to prevent iodine deficiency.
 
• It has a **relatively high atomic number (53)** among non-metals, which contributes to its metallic appearance.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Why Iodine Exhibits Metallic Lustre:**

 
 
• The metallic appearance of iodine is due to the interaction of light with its **delocalized electrons** in the crystalline structure.
 
• This phenomenon is rare among non-metals, making iodine a unique element in terms of its physical properties.
 
 
 
• **Applications of Iodine:**
 
 
• Used in **diagnostic imaging** (iodine-based contrast agents).
 
• Essential in the production of **thyroid hormones**, which regulate metabolism.
 
• Serves as a catalyst in various **chemical reactions**.
